newsitem.title: UK: Logica rebounds after company presentation.
newsitem.headline: Logica rebounds after company presentation.

text.p: Shares in Logica Plc erased early losses and turned higher on Wednesday afternoon following an upbeat presentation by the UK software concern, dealers said.
By 1402 GMT, the shares were up 5p to 957-1/2, having tumbled as low as 915p immediatley after the group released its six-month results.
One analyst, who asked not to be named, said the meeting was "broadly reassuring."
Logica told analysts that the outlook for its markets were "fundamentally positive," and that it saw opportunities for further growth and to improve profit margins.
Earlier, Logica said its pre-tax profits rose 18 percent to 10.6 million in the six months ended December 31.
The shares, which have jumped by eight percent during the last few weeks ahead of the results, tumbled on profit-taking, dealers said. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
